entities.summary: Ilya Sutskever is a computer scientist who specializes in machine learning. He has made several major contributions to the field of deep learning, including sequence-to-sequence learning, reasoning models, GPT models, and contributions to CLIP, DALL-E, and AlphaGo. With Alex Krizhevsky and Geoffrey Hinton, he co-created AlexNet, a convolutional neural network. One of the most highly cited computer scientists in history, he has won the NeurIPS Test of Time Award for his lasting impact on AI research three times in a row (2022-2024) and received the National Academy of Sciences Award for the Industrial Application of Science in 2026.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ilya Sutskever's contributions to deep learning have significantly impacted AI research, with his work on GPT models and CLIP leading to major breakthroughs in natural language processing. His recognition as one of the most highly cited computer scientists in history underscores the far-reaching impact of his research.
